content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the alytaus district court the case involved the division of assets between two parties referred to as the applicant and the defendant the court proceedings occurred on may 9 2023 and the total cost of the case was €830 the case involved the division of an apartment and a vehicle specifically a lexus is220d the case began with a hearing where both parties presented their arguments and evidence the judge then issued a decision ruling in favor of one party the losing party filed an appeal claiming that the judge made errors in their decision the appeal was reviewed by a higher court which upheld the original decision the losing party then filed a motion for reconsideration but the court denied it stating that no new arguments or evidence were presented the losing party now has the option to file a further appeal to a higher court the court has made a decision regarding the division of the apartment the applicant has been granted ownership of the apartment and has been ordered to compensate the defendant with €8300 the court has also stated that the applicant will be responsible for any contractual obligations related to a credit agreement and both parties will be held liable in the event of default the case involves a married couple and the applicant is seeking various outcomes from the court they want to annul the marriage establish the residence of their children with them receive monthly maintenance payments from the defendant for the children be designated as the administrator of the childrens maintenance be assigned the immovable property and vehicle registered under the defendants name hold the defendant responsible for certain contractual obligations receive compensation from the defendant retain their married name and have the defendant pay the costs of the proceedings the applicant explains that the defendant has been irresponsible addicted to alcohol and gambling and has neglected their family they want to dissolve the marriage due to the defendants debts and ensure the wellbeing of the children the applicant is financially supported by their parents and takes care of the childrens daytoday needs they request that the defendant contribute to the childrens maintenance and be held responsible for the debts the court determines the division of assets and liabilities between the parties the applicant owns two plots of land while the parties jointly own an apartment and a vehicle the parties also have outstanding debts the applicant requests to be awarded the apartment and the vehicle as personal property citing the defendants complicated relationship and aggressive behavior they claim sole responsibility for the debts related to credit agreements the value of the assets is €34300 and the debts amount to €1769950 based on the share of assets and deducting the debts the applicant requests the defendant to pay them €8300 as compensation the court awards the apartment and the vehicle to the applicant and orders them to pay the defendant €8300 as compensation the obligations related to the credit agreements remain with the respective parties the court orders the defendant to pay the costs incurred in the proceedings amounting to €550 the payment of stamp duty for a divorce claim and property claim judgment is postponed the defendant is ordered to pay the stamp duty of €830 to the state and the costs of serving procedural documents amounting to €1328 the court upholds the action and annuls the marriage fault part of the defendant the applicant is granted personal property including an apartment and a vehicle and is ordered to pay the defendant €8300 as compensation within two years both parties are held jointly and severally liable for their contractual obligations the defendant is ordered to pay the applicant €550 towards the costs of the proceedings and the stamp duty to the state
